newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Amex launches Australian credit card.
newsitem.headline: Amex launches Australian credit card.

text.p: American Express Co's Australian unit will launch its first credit card, charging a 13.85 percent interest rate, Amex Australia senior vice president John Schaap said on Monday
"This is the first time that American Express has directly challenged the credit card issues on their own turf," Schaap said at the product launch.
American Express has only issued debit cards in Australia until now.

The new card, which is blue to distinguish it from the usual green charge cards, would also have access to the American Express Qantas Airways Ltd membership rewards frequent flyer programme for a A$20 annual fee.
The programme allocates one frequent flier point for each dollar spent and the rewards could also be spent on accomodation and entertainment, Schaap said.
The credit card interest rate would rise to 15.85 percent if a member does not pay their bill on time twice in a year or if their payment cheque is returned.
The card would be available to people with a net annual income of A$25,000 and above, which is below the previous A$35,000 limit for issuance of American Express' previous cards.
There would be no annual fee for the first year and a A$25 fee from the second year on if the annual amount spent is below A$1,500. There would be no joining fee.
"This is probably the best full service credit card deal in Australia from today," Schaap told the launch.
Schaap said American Express Australia aimed to get 250,000 credit card members over the life of the programme.
American Express had launched a credit card in the United States four and a half years ago called Optima and it was now the fastest growing product American Express had there, he said.
"We feel we had some limitation in our growth because we didn't have a credit card," he said of the Australian operations.
American Express expected less than 10 percent of its current charge card members, who have to pay all their balance off at the end of the month, would transfer to the credit card.
